svg.title: Producer map: the records of the hello program, and what two edits evaluate
svg.desc: Columns are the producer stages in rank order, from Discover to NativeInterface, with frozen admitted records in a band on the left. The top panel shows the records a cold build of the two-function hello program produces and the typed reads between them: main's local check reads greeting's name slot and slot, main's lowering demand reads the frozen runtime facade for println, the check scope reads the final records as members, and the native interface reads the plan functions as members and the position maps. The second panel shows the edit of the string in greeting: discover, greeting's declaration source, influence (whose value is equal, so its readers are reused), local, final, Body IR chain, lowering demand and plan function, and the native interface are evaluated; greeting's slot and declaration and every record of main are reused. The third panel shows a comment added above main: only discover, main's position map and the native interface are evaluated. Two insets show a joint group, a mutation-effect forwarding cycle of two functions evaluated once, and an absent witness, a read of a name that does not exist yet.
svg.text: Cold build of the hello program: every record, in rank order
READER TO WHAT IT READ · P PRESENT, A ABSENT, M MEMBERS; UNLABELLED IS P · NOT DRAWN: EACH RECORD'S READ OF ITS OWN DECLARATION SOURCE, AND DOC RECORDS
greeting is checked, lowered and planned again. Its influence value is equal, so its slot and declaration are reused, and main evaluates nothing.
Comment edit: a comment added above main
Header seeds and body projections are equal, so every semantic record is reused. Only main's lines move.
NOT STATED BY THE EDIT MATRIX
MUTATION-EFFECT · KEY = RULE + DIGEST OF SORTED MEMBERSHIP
a forwards to b and b to a: one evaluation runs the fixed point
A dependency cycle is one evaluation.
Each member is published under its own key,
so an equal member value still stops propagation.
from helpers import f, before helpers.incn exists
The read records that nothing is there.
this witness's readers and no one else.
